author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: an open golf ball above a T tee with a slightly cupped top and a peg to the ground. An r14-ball candidate passed but left a 3-unit peg stub and read like a female symbol; the r12 ball gives the peg 6 units. The rejected drawing had a centre dot in the ball (a target look) and a flat T.
omissions: The two tiny dimple dots are dropped (two dots inside a circle read as eyes at 48px); the tee cup is wider than in the reference because it sets the keyshape width.
lucide_reference: Circle over a T stand, Lucide stroke construction.
